description: This header file declares the LiveRegionHost class, which implements the INarratorAnnouncementHost interface. The class is responsible for announcing NarratorAnnouncements via the LiveRegionChanged event, primarily for supporting notifications on older Windows versions (RS2). It includes methods to check host availability, create a host instance, and announce notifications.

classes.name: LiveRegionHost
classes.description: A sealed ref class implementing INarratorAnnouncementHost, used for hosting narrator notifications via live regions on Windows RS2.

methods.name: IsHostAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the live region host is available.

methods.name: MakeHost
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of INarratorAnnouncementHost.
